title: PW Eth: More heuristic tweaks
description:
Accept MAC addresses which are locally assigned, but treat that
as a somewhat weaker heuristic value. With similar heuristic
values, prefer Ethernet without control word, based on the
RFC 8469 recommendation.

Fix #13039
